name: orderflow
description: Event-driven microservices for distributed order processing

scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:model: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && FC_RUNS=${FC_RUNS:-100000} npm run test --workspace=services/order-service
scripts.services:dev: npm run dev --workspace=services/order-service & npm run dev --workspace=services/payment-service & npm run dev --workspace=services/inventory-service
